pages.text: $(italic)Summoner/Necromancer. Commands minions. Vulnerable alone. Your army fights for you.$()$(br2)HP Modifier: -10%  |  Equipment HP: Half effectiveness$(br)$(bold)Weapon Affinities:$() No melee/ranged bonus — personal damage is low by design

pages.title: Passive Abilities
pages.text: $(bold)Soul Tether$() — All summons: +20% damage, +30% max HP, persist 25% longer. Max active summons scales with mana pool.$(br2)$(bold)Life Siphon$() — Summon deals damage: heals you 5% of damage dealt. Summon kills enemy: heal 8% of your max HP.$(br2)$(bold)Void Bond$() — 20% of damage you take is redirected to nearest summon instead.

pages.title: Passive Abilities (cont.)
pages.text: $(bold)Death Harvest$() — Enemies killed by summons: +50% XP, 10% chance to drop a Soul Fragment (summoning cost material).$(br2)$(bold)Necrotic Presence$() — Enemies within 6 blocks: -10% damage, -10% speed aura.

pages.title: Active Ability
pages.text: Active: $(bold)Mass Reanimate$()$(br)Summon Void Specters for 20 seconds. Count scales with mana pool (min 3, up to 8–12 endgame). Each Specter explodes on death for 4-block AoE. 60s cooldown.
